[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Moira Kruger''' settled on [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]] with the intention of raising [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]]. However, the discovery of [[chronamite]] and the poisoning of her bantha herds changed her plans. As the town of [[Corestrike]] grew, Lady Kruger won the [[The Grinder Dance Hall|Grinder Dance Hall]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="HNNA" />

Kruger, alongside [[Mortris Gallorr]] and [[Arno Gallorr]], were part of the [[Magistrate Council]] dealing with criminal trials in Corestrike. However, Kruger was also in a romantic relationship with the criminal [[Themog]]. As a result, her vote on the council was corrupted, allowing criminals to walk free.<ref name="HNNA" />
